facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: The automated trace covers 20 of 20 slices, and after the fix agreement improved from 15.5% within 5 voxels with median distance 22.1 voxels to 59.7% within 5 voxels with median distance 3.6 voxels, so the broad path can be trusted but the exact placement cannot. It is weakest at fine detail, with only 34.0% within 2 voxels given a voxel size of 7.91 micrometres. The starting point is on the clicked layer. A person should check the red line against the yellow dot in the close-up and in slice 0 and slice 19 to confirm it stays on the same sheet and does not jump to a neighbor.
